Metadata.title: AmberAutoBid — Bid, Buy & Ship Cars from Copart & IAAI to Europe
Metadata.description: AmberAutoBid bids and buys vehicles for you at Copart and IAAI auctions in the USA, then handles documentation and ocean freight all the way to your door in Europe.

Footer.tagline: From the auction lane to your driveway — we bid, buy, and ship U.S. vehicles to Europe.
Footer.disclaimer: AmberAutoBid is an independent buying and logistics agent. We purchase on our clients' behalf at Copart and IAAI public auctions and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting as an official representative of Copart or IAAI.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: AmberAutoBid started with a simple frustration: incredible vehicles sell every day at Copart and IAAI auctions across the U.S., but buyers in Europe are locked out — no dealer license, no local presence, no way to inspect a lot in person.

We built a team that lives inside that gap. Buyers who know how to read an auction report, a logistics desk that knows every export document by heart, and a support team that speaks the languages our clients do.

Today we source, buy, and ship vehicles from coast to coast in the U.S. to ports across Northern Europe, the Baltics, and the Caucasus — handling the parts our clients never want to think about twice.
